allowVeryLargeReads.label: Allow very large file reads
allowVeryLargeReads.description: When enabled, AlfaCode assistant will perform very large file or MCP output reads even if there is a high chance of overflowing the context window (content size >80% of context window).

systemNotifications.label: Enable System Notifications
systemNotifications.description: When enabled, AlfaCode assistant will send system notifications for important events like task completion or errors.
systemNotifications.testMessage: This is a test notification from AlfaCode assistant.

alfaCode.description: Centralized AlfaCode assistant features and quality/cost controls: prompt helpers, condensing profile, terminal generator, and fast apply routing.
alfaCode.fastApplyDescription: Configure the faster apply-model route used by AlfaCode assistant for patch-heavy work.
alfaCode.imageGenerationDescription: Manage AlfaCode assistant image generation providers here, including a dedicated LiteLLM profile.

presets.title: Quality presets
presets.description: Apply a recommended context-routing preset depending on whether you want maximum quality, balanced cost, or minimum token usage.

taskStrategy.title: Task strategy
taskStrategy.description: Use the cheapest workflow that still preserves quality before escalating to a more expensive context reset.
taskStrategy.summary: Recommended order: stay local for focused follow-ups, compact when the thread gets long, and start a new task only when the goal or code area truly changes.

local.title: Local follow-up
local.description: Best for small fixes, short clarifications, and continuing the same focused subtask without widening context.

compact.title: Compact context
compact.description: Use when the conversation is long but the goal is unchanged, so history can be compressed instead of paying for a fresh task.

newTask.title: New task
newTask.description: Reserve for genuinely new goals, unrelated code areas, or when you want a clean context boundary between jobs.

routing.title: Model routing
routing.description: Route cheaper profiles to lightweight subtasks and keep your main chat profile for harder reasoning and final synthesis.

primary.label: Primary chat profile
primary.description: Used for the main conversation, complex reasoning, and final answers.

enhance.label: Prompt enhancement profile
enhance.description: Good place for a cheaper model when rewriting or polishing prompts before work.

condense.label: Context condensing profile
condense.description: Best candidate for a low-cost model because it summarizes long context and compacts history.

terminal.label: Terminal command profile
terminal.description: Use a faster or cheaper model for shell command generation and command formatting.

presets.title: Routing presets
presets.description: Apply a one-click routing strategy for helper subtasks without changing your main chat profile.
presets.localProfileUnavailable: No local Ollama or LM Studio helper profile is available yet.

enabled.label: Enable parallel agents
enabled.description: Allow AlfaCode assistant to launch several agent branches for a root task. When disabled, root tasks run sequentially.

count.label: Parallel agents count
count.description: Maximum number of parallel agents for a root task. If capacity is not available, AlfaCode assistant falls back to sequential execution.

autoRestartProblematicProcesses.label: Automatically restart problematic processes
autoRestartProblematicProcesses.description: When enabled, AlfaCode assistant will automatically restart a problematic branch or process after loop or stall protection stops it.

problematicProcessRestartLimit.label: Restart attempts
problematicProcessRestartLimit.description: Maximum number of automatic restart attempts for a problematic branch or process before manual action is required.

largeReads.title: Large file safety
largeReads.label: Allow very large reads
largeReads.description: Disable the oversized/minified-file guard and allow full reads for very large files when you explicitly need them. This can increase token usage and risk context overflow.

diagnostics.title: Local AI diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Run a deterministic health check for Ollama, LiteLLM, local helper routing, and local retrieval components when configured.

expert.title: Expert controls
expert.description: Tune structured delegation, evaluator usage, and retrieval behavior for advanced AlfaCode workflows.

structuredDelegation.label: Structured delegation
structuredDelegation.description: Require explicit goal and acceptance criteria for delegated tasks, with safer fallback to direct execution when the handoff is incomplete.

evaluatorPass.label: Evaluator pass
evaluatorPass.description: Allow an additional evaluator step for expensive, low-confidence, or conflicting helper results before synthesis.

retrievalPolicy.label: Retrieval policy
retrievalPolicy.description: Choose how aggressively AlfaCode combines semantic search, hybrid search, and reranking for repository retrieval.

queryClassifierDebug.label: Query classifier debug
queryClassifierDebug.description: Expose internal retrieval intent classification in advanced flows to inspect how repository search strategy was selected.

timeline.label: Show task timeline
timeline.description: Display grouped task progress in chat so it is easier to follow long-running work.

orchestrationTelemetry.title: Orchestration telemetry
orchestrationTelemetry.label: Enable routing telemetry
orchestrationTelemetry.description: Store privacy-safe routing metadata for helper and subagent decisions.

helperLocality.title: Local helper preference
helperLocality.description: Control whether helper tasks should stay local whenever possible.

escalationSensitivity.title: Escalation sensitivity
escalationSensitivity.description: Control when cheaper helper flows should escalate back to the stronger main model.

apiConfigId.label: API Configuration
apiConfigId.description: Select which API configuration to use for generating terminal commands. Leave as 'Use Current Configuration' to use your default settings.

codeIndex.embeddingBatchSizeDescription: Number of code segments to batch together for embedding generation and vector store upserts. Higher values can improve indexing speed but may increase memory usage. Lower values reduce memory usage but may slow down indexing.
codeIndex.embedderRequestsPerMinuteDescription: Limits how frequently the indexer can send HTTP requests to your embeddings provider while indexing. Lower values reduce load and the risk of 429 rate-limit errors, but make indexing slower.
codeIndex.scannerMaxBatchRetriesDescription: Maximum number of times to retry a failed batch during directory scanning. Higher values increase resilience to transient errors but may slow down indexing if errors persist. Lower values fail faster but may skip content on temporary issues.

description.workflows: Workflows are a prepared template for a conversation. Workflows can allow you to define prompts you use frequently, and can include a series of steps to guide AlfaCode assistant through repetitive tasks, such as deploying a service or submitting a PR. toolCallStyle.description: Choose how tool calls are formatted in the system prompt. JSON is currently experimental and mostly intended for users interested in contributing to its development.

enableAutoTrigger.label: Auto-trigger Suggestions
enableAutoTrigger.description: Automatically show inline code suggestions when you pause typing.

autoTriggerDelay.label: Auto Trigger Delay
autoTriggerDelay.description: The delay in seconds before suggestions appear after you pause typing. A shorter delay means quicker suggestions, but may be more resource-intensive.

enableSmartInlineTaskKeybinding.label: Trigger on Keybinding ({{keybinding}})
enableSmartInlineTaskKeybinding.description: Press {{keybinding}} to request a code suggestion at your cursor position. <DocsLink>Edit shortcut</DocsLink>

enableChatAutocomplete.label: Enable Chat Autocomplete
enableChatAutocomplete.description: Show completions as you type in the chat input. Press Tab to accept suggestions.

snooze.label: Snooze Suggestions
snooze.description: Temporarily pause suggestions for a specified duration.
